hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.program: New York State Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Wadsworth Center

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.program: New York State â 10 NYCRR Â§12.2
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: 10 NYCRR §12.2 makes eye prophylaxis a duty of the attending provider; no standalone state declination form — practice standard is a signed informed-refusal/waiver document (app master form).
